relationships.subject: Peripheral nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: after PNI, microglia undergo a transient, proliferation-driven transcriptional response

relationships.subject: LPS
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that LPS induced significant upregulation of these genes, whereas morphine had no such effect at any concentration

relationships.subject: Morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: the lack of transcriptional evidence of LPS-like signaling in response to morphine both in vivo and in vitro argues against direct TLR4 activation

key_findings: Chronic morphine induced no significant change in spinal microglial gene expression despite morphological activation, unlike nerve injury models.
Nerve injury (SNT, CCI) triggers an early proliferative microglial transcriptional response at 1-2 dpi, absent after morphine.
